record.notes: The tracker's EUR 10.00 is a rounding of the vendor's EUR 9.99, so the two sources agree to the cent and the record carries the vendor figure. The page states a 99.9 percent uptime claim in prose, which is a stated term and not an observed event. Unverified: whether the 1000 Mbit uplink is shared or guaranteed per VM, and whether the 2 TB is enforced by shaping. Rendering and provenance: currency symbols are written out (EUR, GBP, RUB, VND), diacritics in place names are folded to ASCII, and a price the page splits across two lines is joined as value/period; the tracker page stated 'Database update: 7 hours ago' when it was read on 2026-10-22.
